requirements.requirement_name: Live Webcam Photo Capture / Scanned Photograph
requirements.content_instructions: Portal Webcam Stream / JPG, JPEG; Live webcam capture via onlinebpsc.bihar.gov.in OR uploaded photo max 25 KB; 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm; Plain white or light background; Automated camera validation on portal; max file limit 25 KB for upload mode

JPG, JPEG; 220 x 100 pixels; maximum 15 KB; 3.5 cm x 1.5 cm; Plain white background; Mandatory signature in Devnagari / Hindi script; capital letters or typed font invalid; Enforced max 15 KB (or 20 KB) and 220x100 px by BPSC portal

dimensions.fallback_reason: The body publishes a preferred pixel size without mandating it, so the size is honoured while the mode stays unspecified.
